mapper.insert: insert ignore into coop_settlement_adjustment (settlement_id, claim_id, entry_kind, event_key, amount, status, create_time) values (#{settlementId}, #{claimId}, #{entryKind}, #{eventKey}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select id, settlement_id, claim_id, entry_kind, event_key, amount, status, create_time from coop_settlement_adjustment where claim_id = #{claimId} and entry_kind = #{entryKind} and event_key = #{eventKey} for update
select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from coop_settlement_adjustment where settlement_id = #{settlementId} and status = 'EXECUTED'
select id,settlement_id,claim_id,entry_kind,event_key,amount,status,create_time from coop_settlement_adjustment where settlement_id=#{settlementId} and status='EXECUTED' order by id for update
